followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: The query is a well-scoped factual/extraction-style request ("identify three aspects") with explicit, bounded completion criteria — exactly the kind of task Plover both prefers and scores highest on (Extraction & Retrieval 79.2, plus its top-rated task family). The two models are effectively tied on most evals, so I leaned on this task-type fit. The "don't ramble" instruction also favors a low-latitude, clearly-specified response over open-ended generation, which reinforces Plover over Avocet.
